description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

AngelAi, the fintech innovation arm of Sun West Mortgage Company, is developing an emotionally responsive mobile interface for mortgage lending and financial services. The Software Engineer will help build AI-driven experiences and commercial products that adapt workflows to users’ emotional cues.
Software Engineer contributing to AI-driven React and Node.js products that interpret emotional cues and adapt personalized user workflows

Responsibilities:
• In this role, you will contribute to building AI-driven experiences that go beyond traditional systems based solely on empirical data
• You will have the freedom to choose problems, develop solutions, and deliver commercial products with unique user experiences
• Detect and interpret users' emotional states
• Dynamically adjust workflows based on emotional cues
• Deliver personalized, intuitive experiences that feel human

Requirements:
• Strong proficiency in one or more core programming languages: Python, C++, Java, or Node.js
• Experience building scalable systems or AI-driven applications
• Curiosity, creativity, and an interest in challenging traditional approaches
• Comfort working with ambiguity and a passion for solving real-world problems
• Willingness to learn, discipline, and passion for the work
